skill.summary: Build the Clawdbot macOS menu bar app from source. Use when you need to install the Clawdbot.app companion (for menu bar status, permissions, and Mac hardware access like camera/screen recording). Handles dependency installation, UI build, Swift compilation, code signing, and app packaging automatically.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the skill to build the Clawdbot macOS companion app from source.

- Automates the full build process: dependency install, UI build, Swift compilation, code signing, and packaging.
- Supports both ad-hoc and Developer ID signing for local or production builds.
- Includes detailed build instructions, troubleshooting steps, and prerequisite requirements.
- Enables macOS app features: menu bar status, hardware access, notifications, and deep linking.
- Provides guidance for installing, launching, and configuring the app after build.
